tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "What happened to Tom's finger?"
B hears the question and builds the answer. The tile "-self / each other" means: choose! One person does it to themselves → myself, himself, themselves … Two people do it to one another → each other.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
